_comment: WingtipToys: every user-facing operation of corpora/regression/wt.operations.json (wt.operations.md), each step's op naming the operations it exercises. Golden: corpora/parity/wt.operations.golden.json, recorded on the original on IIS by corpora/record-wt-operations.ps1; verified by experiments/wf4c/verify-windows.ps1 -Name wt -Suite operations and experiments/wf4c/run-linux.ps1 ... -Suite operations. Every run starts from a dropped database (the application's start creates and seeds it). Users: parity.user1/2@example.com (registered here), the seeded administrator canEditUser@wingtiptoys.com. External requests of the browser are stubbed (stubExternal); the server's call to PayPal's sandbox API is real (it answers 10002 Security error for the sample's placeholder credentials).

steps._phase: 1. Anonymous browsing (a new browser: no cookies)
2. Static content, request filtering, not found
4. Mobile view (FriendlyUrls: the switch, and a phone's browser)

steps.value: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.0 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1

steps.name: db-cart-anonymous
steps.value: SELECT CASE WHEN CartId LIKE '%-%-%-%-%' THEN 'session guid' ELSE CartId END AS Cart, ProductId, Quantity FROM CartItems ORDER BY ProductId
const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('#MainContent_CartList tr')].find(r => r.cells[0] && r.cells[0].innerText.trim() === '2'); row.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]').checked = true;

steps._phase: 6. Register (from the checkout's login page: the anonymous cart, the return URL)

steps.name: db-users-after-register
steps.value: SELECT UserName, Email, EmailConfirmed, PhoneNumber, TwoFactorEnabled, LockoutEnabled, AccessFailedCount, CASE WHEN PasswordHash IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS HasPassword FROM AspNetUsers ORDER BY UserName

steps.name: db-cart-after-register
steps.value: SELECT CASE WHEN CartId = (SELECT Id FROM AspNetUsers WHERE UserName = 'parity.user1@example.com') THEN 'user1 Id' WHEN CartId LIKE '%-%-%-%-%' THEN 'session guid' ELSE CartId END AS Cart, ProductId, Quantity FROM CartItems ORDER BY ProductId

steps.name: db-cart-after-login
steps.value: SELECT CASE WHEN CartId = (SELECT Id FROM AspNetUsers WHERE UserName = 'parity.user1@example.com') THEN 'user1 Id' WHEN CartId LIKE '%-%-%-%-%' THEN 'session guid' ELSE CartId END AS Cart, ProductId, Quantity FROM CartItems ORDER BY Cart, ProductId

steps._phase: 8. Checkout (logged in): PayPal's sandbox answers with an error for the sample's credentials

steps.name: db-orders
steps.value: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM Orders; SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrderDetails FROM OrderDetails

steps._phase: 10. Phone number (the SMS code made from the user's security stamp, as the application's provider checks it)

steps.value: SELECT SecurityStamp FROM AspNetUsers WHERE UserName = 'parity.user1@example.com'

steps.name: db-phone
steps.value: SELECT UserName, PhoneNumber, PhoneNumberConfirmed FROM AspNetUsers WHERE UserName = 'parity.user1@example.com'

steps._phase: 11. External logins (a Google login linked in the database: the application's own linking needs Google)

steps.value: INSERT INTO AspNetUserLogins (LoginProvider, ProviderKey, UserId) SELECT 'Google', 'parity-google-key', Id FROM AspNetUsers WHERE UserName = 'parity.user1@example.com'

steps.name: db-logins
steps.value: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Logins FROM AspNetUserLogins

steps._phase: 12. A user without a password (removed in the database, as an external-login-only account has none)

steps.value: UPDATE AspNetUsers SET PasswordHash = NULL WHERE UserName = 'parity.user1@example.com'

steps.name: db-password-set
steps.value: SELECT UserName, CASE WHEN PasswordHash IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS HasPassword FROM AspNetUsers WHERE UserName = 'parity.user1@example.com'

steps._phase: 13. Two-factor authentication (enabled in the database: the application's buttons for it are commented out)

steps.value: UPDATE AspNetUsers SET TwoFactorEnabled = 1, EmailConfirmed = 1 WHERE UserName = 'parity.user2@example.com'
SELECT SecurityStamp FROM AspNetUsers WHERE UserName = 'parity.user2@example.com'

steps.name: db-access-failed-4
steps.value: SELECT AccessFailedCount, CASE WHEN LockoutEndDateUtc IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS LockedOut FROM AspNetUsers WHERE UserName = 'parity.user2@example.com'

steps.name: db-locked-out
steps.value: SELECT AccessFailedCount, CASE WHEN LockoutEndDateUtc > GETUTCDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LockedOut FROM AspNetUsers WHERE UserName = 'parity.user2@example.com'

steps._phase: 14. Forgotten password, confirmation, reset (anonymous; their tokens are only made by commented-out code)

steps.value: UPDATE AspNetUsers SET EmailConfirmed = 1 WHERE UserName = 'parity.user1@example.com'

steps._phase: 15. External login (Google): the redirect to Google, the callback without Google's answer
16. Authorization: what an anonymous user is refused
17. Forged requests: the master page's anti-XSRF check, the view state's MAC, event validation, request validation
18. Administration: a user who is not in canEdit, then the administrator
